title: Cynegyrus
summary: Raleigh names Cynegyrus in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Cynegyrus, who followed the Persians to their Gallies at Marathon and held one with his hands and then his teeth. The printed spelling is kept. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book III, Part I, Chapter V, §. VIII, sig. 410a
